nodes.name: Boost.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the per-perk damage boost system for the damage calculator. Includes BoostContext interface (context passed to boost calc functions), BoostDef interface (boost definition schema), the BOOST_DEFS array (all 40+ perk damage/heal boost definitions with multipliers and calc functions), BOOST_DEF_MAP lookup, and utility functions for Minion Absorption and Frenzy calculations.

nodes.name: perk-base-damage.ts
nodes.summary: Defines base damage constants for 30+ perk abilities and special attacks including Dragon Claw, Dragon Bubble, Springblast, various spirits, Bounce Momentum, Air Pressure, Air Barrier, Roaring Heads, Barbed Flurry, Honey Arts, Sickness, Melting Slime, Whirlwind, Volatile Shell, Royal Finisher, Grounded Despair, Echo Incineration, Venom Spitter, Spore Burst, Apollo Boost, HP Gates, Bomber Charge, Dark Harvest, Pyre Bloom, Bastion Ballista, Runic Blades, Gnawing Poison, Propelling Fun, Quake, and Ruler Of The Sands.

nodes.name: perks.ts
nodes.summary: Defines perk-related gameplay constants including potion/damage scaling percentages (Potion Chugger, Luminescent, Spirit Winds, Dark Magic, etc.), crit base values and formulas (BASE_CRIT_DAMAGE, Thief Training, Venom Eater, Vital Strikes, Spark, etc.), and special perk mechanics (Mortal Will, Sunburn, Frostbite, Fiery Pursuit, Hypnotist, Phantom Pain, Pursuit).

nodes.name: storage.ts
nodes.summary: Defines localStorage persistence keys (build, defenses, level, HP fill, saves), BUILD_STATE_DEFAULTS (default build configuration), SAVE_KEY_MAP/UNMAP (compressed key mappings for save data), ENCH_MAP/UNMAP (equipment-to-enchantment slot mappings), and UI configuration (MAX_BUILD_SLOTS, CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_MS).

nodes.name: BoostContext
nodes.summary: Context object passed to boost calculation functions. Contains perk levels, naturalCritChance, jumpBoost, summonCount, ragePotency, bouncePotency, quickdrawPotency, tailwindPotency, airBoost, tenacity, speedBoost, attackSpeed, inDarkness, emotionalState, level, mountActive, summonBoostPct, selectedWeaponArt, hpFillPct, hasFireDmg, burnPotency, hasBurn, selfDebuffCount, hasMagicDmg, hasMagicOrPhysicalDmg, enemyHpFillPct.

nodes.name: BoostDef
nodes.summary: Defines the schema for a damage/heal boost entry: sourceName, type (dmg/heal), multiplierPerPerk, condition, isLevel, calcFn (custom calculation function), appliesTo (attack type filter), needsProcCoeff, procScaling, hasToggle, baseProcChance.

nodes.name: BOOST_DEFS
nodes.summary: Array of 40+ BoostDef entries defining all per-perk damage/heal multipliers. Includes simple boosts (Blood Thirsty, Venom Spitter, Frostbite, etc.), complex calcFn-based boosts (Primal, Spring Powered, Thief Training, Frenzy, Juggernaut, Vampire, Penance, Cut Down, Executioner, etc.), and level damage. Each entry may have appliesTo, needsProcCoeff, procScaling, and hasToggle properties.

nodes.name: BOOST_DEF_MAP
nodes.summary: Map from sourceName string to BoostDef entry for O(1) lookup of boost definitions.

nodes.name: calcMinionAbsorptionPotency
nodes.summary: Calculates Minion Absorption damage potency: MINION_ABSORPTION_MULT * (summonBoostPct/100) * stacks, rounded to 4 decimal places.

nodes.name: calcFrenzyPct
nodes.summary: Calculates Frenzy damage percentage: FRENZY_BASE + FRENZY_RAGE_MULT * ragePotency.

nodes.name: PENANCE_HP_THRESHOLD
nodes.summary: HP threshold (35%) for Penance perk: at or below this HP%, Penance provides max boost and procs bleed.

nodes.name: PENANCE_MAX_BOOST
nodes.summary: Maximum damage boost cap (0.25 = +25%) for Penance perk.

nodes.name: PENANCE_BLEED_POTENCY
nodes.summary: Bleed potency for Penance (0 - status-only bleed, no damage).

nodes.name: PENANCE_BLEED_DURATION
nodes.summary: Bleed duration in seconds (5s) for Penance perk.

edges.description: Boost.ts imports boost multiplier constants (FRENZY_BASE, MINION_ABSORPTION_MULT, BLOOD_THIRSTY_MULT_PER_STACK, etc.) from the constants barrel
Boost.ts imports BoostAttackType and ProcScalingType types from types.ts
Boost.ts imports roundMultiplier utility function from utils.ts
storage.ts imports DEFAULT_LEVEL and DEFAULT_HP_FILL from game.ts for build state defaults
Boost.ts defines the BOOST_DEFS array
Boost.ts defines the BOOST_DEF_MAP lookup
Boost.ts defines the BoostContext interface
Boost.ts defines the BoostDef interface
Boost.ts defines calcMinionAbsorptionPotency function
Boost.ts defines calcFrenzyPct function
Boost.ts defines PENANCE_HP_THRESHOLD constant
Boost.ts defines PENANCE_MAX_BOOST constant
Boost.ts defines PENANCE_BLEED_POTENCY constant
Boost.ts defines PENANCE_BLEED_DURATION constant
BOOST_DEF_MAP is constructed from BOOST_DEFS array via new Map(BOOST_DEFS.map(...))
BOOST_DEFS is typed as BoostDef[] and each entry conforms to the BoostDef interface
BoostDef.appliesTo references BoostAttackType type and BoostDef.procScaling references ProcScalingType from types.ts
calcMinionAbsorptionPotency uses MINION_ABSORPTION_MULT constant from constants.ts
calcFrenzyPct uses FRENZY_BASE and FRENZY_RAGE_MULT constants from constants.ts
Many BOOST_DEFS entries reference multiplier constants imported from constants.ts (BLOOD_THIRSTY_MULT_PER_STACK, VENOM_SPITTER_MULT_PER_STACK, PERFECTION_MULT_PER_STACK, etc.)
Several BOOST_DEFS calcFn implementations use roundMultiplier from utils.ts (Spring Powered, Thief Training, Vassals Croak, Raging Bounce, etc.)
